d: Tuwaiq Casting & Forging is seeking an experienced and technically strong IT Infrastructure Manager to join the IT Department. Reporting to the IT Director, this role is responsible for planning, implementing, managing, and securing the organisation's IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, cloud platforms, storage systems, cybersecurity solutions, and communication systems. The role ensures high availability, reliability, and security of all IT services while supporting business operations and digital transformation initiatives.
q: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, or Computer Science
Minimum 10 years of IT experience, including at least 3–5 years in infrastructure management.
r: Manage enterprise network infrastructure including LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, and firewalls
Oversee server environments, virtualisation platforms, and cloud services
Ensure optimal performance, availability, and capacity planning of IT systems
Maintain storage solutions, backup systems, and disaster recovery sites
Manage data centre and server room infrastructure
Manage IP telephony and communication systems.
Implement and maintain IT security controls and policies
Manage firewalls, endpoint protection, access controls, and vulnerability remediation
Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards, IT policies, and regulatory requirements
Conduct risk assessments and security reviews.
Ensure 24/7 availability of critical IT services
Lead incident management and problem resolution activities
Monitor infrastructure health and system performance
Manage system upgrades, patches, and technology refresh initiatives.
Develop and maintain disaster recovery and business continuity plans
Conduct periodic backup verification and recovery testing
Minimise operational risks through proactive infrastructure management.
Lead and mentor system administrators, network engineers, and IT support staff
Assign tasks, monitor performance, and support staff development
Promote best practices and continuous improvement within the IT team.
Support digital transformation initiatives and new technology deployments
Coordinate with business departments and external partners
Coordinate infrastructure requirements for ERP, MES, CCTV, access control, telecommunications, and other business systems.

d: Sales Manager – IT Services & Technology Solutions

We are seeking an experienced B2B Sales professional based in or around Riyadh to drive new business development and revenue growth across the Riyadh market. The role will focus on identifying and developing enterprise opportunities, building relationships with senior technology and business stakeholders, and positioning technology-led solutions to address complex client requirements.

The ideal candidate will have a strong track record of enterprise sales, new business acquisition, and consultative selling within the Riyadh market, with experience across IT services, technology solutions, digital transformation, cloud, managed services, or enterprise technology. The successful candidate will be commercially driven, confident in engaging with senior decision-makers, and capable of managing the complete sales cycle from prospecting through to successful closure.
q: 10+ years of experience in B2B sales, enterprise technology sales, IT services, technology consulting, or related domains.
Demonstrated experience in new business development and enterprise deal closures .
Strong understanding of one or more areas such as IT services, cloud solutions, digital transformation, application services, infrastructure, managed services, or enterprise technology .
Experience selling to mid-market or enterprise customers and engaging with senior stakeholders.
Strong business communication, presentation, negotiation, and consultative selling skills.
Hands-on experience using CRM platforms for opportunity tracking, pipeline management, and sales forecasting.
Ability to independently manage a territory while effectively coordinating with internal teams.
Strong commercial acumen with a result-oriented approach to achieving sales and revenue goals.
A strategic and target-driven sales professional who can open new accounts, build senior-level relationships, understand technology requirements, and convert complex B2B opportunities into revenue.
r: Own sales and business development activities for the assigned geography and work towards achieving revenue targets.
Identify potential enterprise clients through market mapping, outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, and industry connections.
Develop relationships with CXOs, CIOs/CTOs, IT heads, procurement teams, and other senior decision-makers .
Manage opportunities throughout the sales cycle, including prospecting, qualification, requirement discovery, solution positioning, proposals, commercial discussions, negotiations, and closure.
Engage with clients to understand their business and technology requirements and recommend relevant IT solutions and services.
Work closely with technical, presales, delivery, and leadership teams to create customized solution proposals and presentations.
Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide regular updates on opportunity status, expected closures, and revenue forecasts.
Lead client discussions, business presentations, negotiations, and commercial conversations.
Track developments in the technology market, customer needs, and competitive landscape to identify new business opportunities.
Contribute to customer acquisition, revenue growth, and expansion of existing client relationships.
